definitions.explanation: A state of physical and mental exhaustion caused by prolonged stress or overwork, leaving a person feeling drained and unable to function effectively.

examples.japanese: {燃|も}え{尽|つ}き⟦{症候群|しょうこうぐん}→症候群：30368_shoukougun⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{注意|ちゅうい}→注意：01464_chuui⟧⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧⟦ください→下さい：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Please be careful of burnout syndrome.

examples.japanese: ⟦{仕事|しごと}→仕事：00480_shigoto⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{頑張|がんば}り→頑張る：01222_ganbaru⟧すぎて{燃|も}え{尽|つ}きてしまった。
examples.english: I overworked myself and burned out.

examples.japanese: {燃|も}え{尽|つ}き⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{防|ふせ}ぐ→防ぐ：02409_fusegu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦{適度|てきど}→適度：03441_tekido⟧な⟦{休息|きゅうそく}→休息：02587_kyuusoku⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{欠|か}かせない→欠かす：10138_kakasu⟧。
examples.english: Adequate rest is essential to prevent burnout.

notes:
USAGE:
{燃|も}え{尽|つ}き is the noun form of the verb {燃|も}え{尽|つ}きる (to burn out completely). While the verb can describe literal burning, the noun {燃|も}え{尽|つ}き is almost always used in the psychological/medical sense of burnout.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {燃|も}え{尽|つ}き⟦{症候群|しょうこうぐん}→症候群：30368_shoukougun⟧ (burnout syndrome)
- {燃|も}え{尽|つ}き⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{防|ふせ}ぐ→防ぐ：02409_fusegu⟧ (to prevent burnout)
- {燃|も}え{尽|つ}き⟦{状態|じょうたい}→状態：03345_joutai⟧ (state of burnout)

FORMS:
{燃|も}え{尽|つ}きる means "to burn out" or "to be completely exhausted." The phrase ⟦{真|ま}っ{白|しろ}→真っ白：07613_masshiro⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{燃|も}え{尽|つ}きた (burned out pure white) is a famous line from the manga and anime あした⟦の→の：09472_no⟧ジョー.
